class_profile.average_high_school_gpa.evidence: C12 box 'Average high school GPA of all degree-seeking, first-time, first-year students who submitted GPA:' literally renders '0.00%' (a percent-formatted token on a GPA-scale field, which is internally inconsistent for a GPA value). The immediately preceding C11 GPA-distribution table (same page) has every individual range row (4.0, 3.75-3.99, ... below 1.0) left completely empty by the institution, with only the auto-computed 'Totals should = 100%' row showing 0.00% -- the classic signature of an unfilled CDS Excel template where formula cells default to zero over an empty input range. Treating C12 as a real reported GPA of 0.00 (impossible on a 4.0 scale) would be wrong; this is the institution leaving C11/C12 blank, not reporting a zero. ambiguous: a literal-text reading would instead record status present, value '0.00%'.
